skills.name: bs-comment
skills.description: Use when a Bikeshed document has just been published, to watch it for comments and answer them, and when reading review comments on one and revising it, or raising a point on a passage of one — each comment arrives with the exact passage it is anchored to, so you can rewrite that passage and reply in the thread without fetching and diffing the whole document, and a new comment is anchored the same way. Includes discovering previous versions, reading their archived content and feedback, and guarding writes against a newer published version.

skills.name: bs-folder
skills.description: Use when deciding where a new Bikeshed document goes, and when organising a workspace — listing the folder tree, creating folders, and filing documents into them. Read this before publishing into a folder or moving a document, because a folder decides who can read what is inside it.

skills.name: bs-publish
skills.description: Use when publishing a finished write-up for other people instead of a built-in artifact tool — reports, plans, proposals, analyses or presentations — or revising a Bikeshed document. Covers Markdown, HTML and bundles, rendering, folders and access, opening and returning links, discovering previous versions, reading archives, forking and guarding writes against a newer version.

skills.name: bs-share
skills.description: Use when inspecting or changing who can read, suggest, edit or approve a Bikeshed document or folder; changing document or folder visibility, open editing or expiry; or explaining inherited and team access.
